reviews.author: Orhun B.
reviews.text: Excellent extension! It works smoothly and does exactly what I need. Very useful, easy to use, and saves me a lot of time when using WhatsApp Web. I’m really happy with it and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable WhatsApp Web extension. Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Tuna B.
reviews.text: This extension offers fantastic features! The Privacy Screen feature is especially useful when working in the office or sharing your screen. It works flawlessly and makes a real difference. Many thanks to the developers for creating such a useful extension!
